label: Wireless power transfer
description: Wireless charging of phones, vehicles and devices: coils, resonant circuits, detection of foreign metal objects.
placeholder: For example: a charging pad that detects metal objects on its surface and reduces power to avoid heating them.
examples: A wireless charging pad that detects a metal object lying on its surface and lowers the transmitted power to avoid heating the object.
A system that helps a driver park an electric vehicle over a ground charging coil by measuring the position of the vehicle coil and guiding the driver.
A wireless charger with several transmitting coils that selects the coil with the best coupling to the receiving device and switches off the others.

label: Coffee and beverage machines
description: Machines that brew coffee and other hot drinks: capsules, pumps, grinders, milk frothers.
placeholder: For example: a coffee machine that reads a code on the capsule and adjusts the water temperature and volume.
examples: A coffee machine that reads a code on the capsule and adjusts the water temperature, pressure and volume accordingly.
A device that heats and froths milk with steam and automatically rinses its milk line after each use.
A brewing machine with a built-in grinder that adjusts the grind size according to the extraction time of the previous cup.
